newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to sell 7.5 pct stake in steel firm.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to sell 7.5 pct stake in steel firm.

text.p: State-owned National Development Company (NDC) said on Thursday it would sell its 7.5 percent stake in National Steel Corp (NSC) through a public bidding to be held later this month.
The government's investment arm will sell 168,157,518 NSC shares with an indicative price of ten pesos per share, an NDC official said.
The public bidding is set on May 27, with the pre-bidding conference on May 23.
NDC currently owns 12.5 percent of the country's biggest producer of semi-finished steel products, supplying over 40 percent of the flat and long products market.
The remaining five percent state-held shares would be sold through an initial public offering in the coming years.
The majority stake is owned by Hottick Investments Ltd of Hong Kong.

"In the event of a failed bidding, NDC may, at its sole option, immediately or as soon as practicable enter into negotiation for the purpose of arriving at a mutually acceptable price and terms," the NDC said.
